page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.7xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, delivering a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB RAM per virtual processor. It operates without discrete GPU acceleration hardware.

The server does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring external cloud block storage for operating system images and persistent operational data. Additionally, no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provisioned by default, which means public connectivity relies on assigned network gateways or elastic IP addresses.

With its dedicated core allocation and balanced memory capacity, the instance offers predictable resource density for enterprise environments. Trade-offs include the requirement for external storage architecture and the lack of hardware accelerators. This configuration is aligned with enterprise backend application serving, relational database instances, container management nodes, and distributed CI/CD build pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.7xlarge is an x86_64 architecture general-purpose virtual machine provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 32 dedicated vCPUs paired with 128.0 GB of system memory, establishing a standard 1:4 core-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include integrated local storage or hardware GPU acceleration, requiring reliance on external cloud storage volumes for all system and persistent data needs. Additionally, the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating external network attachment for external routing. The allocation of dedicated compute resources combined with substantial memory capacity makes this configuration suitable for scaled production deployments, including enterprise application backends, container orchestration nodes, relational database workloads, and distributed CI/CD build environments requiring predictable multi-core execution.
